_comment: The source of truth for continent placement and the Luna Sea/Bruma geography -- docs/01_Nevora_World_Generation_Architecture.md §5 was corrected 2026-08-10 to actually specify these numbers after the first implementation pass produced a sea gap smaller than either continent (reads as a strait, not the 'large ocean separating continents' the master prompt calls for). See docs/03 §1.

bruma.name: The Bruma
bruma.notes: Mysterious central waters of the Luna Sea -- storm-prone, magically anomalous, avoided by ordinary sailors. Midpoint of the sea gap between Valora's east coast and Seradia's west coast.
